prompt:
Scene illustration for a Japanese adventure game on a 16-bit home computer of the late 1980s and early 1990s, shown in the picture window of the game screen: high-resolution 640x400 pixel art with only 16 colours on screen, chosen from a 4096-colour palette. Crisp, clean anime-style line art: every building, boat, rock, barrel and post has a thin dark outline of one pixel, no anti-aliasing, no blur. Flat cel shading with one light and one shadow tone per surface. All gradients (sky, sea, glow around the lit window) are made only from regular ordered dithering patterns between two neighbouring colours: fine checkerboard raster, 25% and 75% dot grids, horizontal line patterns, never smooth blends and never noise. Calm, precise, slightly melancholic visual-novel mood. Dusk palette with few colours: deep indigo and violet sky with dithered bands, a band of orange and pink light at the horizon, dark blue sea with short horizontal light dashes, cool grey stone, warm brown wood, warm yellow window light. Camera: medium-wide view from standing eye level onto the harbour. Composition: the cottage with its lit window and the lantern post fill the left quarter, the lighthouse on its rocky headland stands at the right edge with its lamp at about 25% of the image height, the wooden jetty with the two moored boats lies right of centre, horizon at about 45% of the height; the centre and lower centre show open water and plain quay paving, because a character portrait will be placed there later. The lighthouse lamp only as a small glowing yellow spot without any beam or rays, no smoke from the chimney (both are animated separately). Avoid: painterly digital painting, soft airbrush gradients, photorealism, 3D rendering, a postcard look, modern pixel art with hundreds of colours, lens flare, bloom.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Character portrait sheet for a Japanese adventure game on a 16-bit home computer of the late 1980s and early 1990s: high-resolution 640x400 pixel art with only 16 colours, anime-style character art as in early-1990s computer visual novels. Crisp black outlines of even width around every shape, flat cel shading with exactly one shadow tone per material, no anti-aliasing, no soft gradients, no airbrush; where a soft transition is needed (fur, cheeks, folds of the scarf) it is made only from a fine regular checkerboard or dot-grid dithering pattern. Clean readable shapes, few small details, simple fur drawn as flat areas with a few jagged edge strokes, not as fine hair texture. The sheet shows the same character twice, side by side, at exactly the same size, same pose and same position within each half, everything identical except the face: LEFT: eyes open with a small white highlight, mouth closed in a friendly smile. RIGHT: eyes closed as two short curved lines (a blink), mouth open as if speaking a word. Both are half-length portraits from the waist up, the body turned three-quarters toward the viewer, head turned toward the viewer, the parcel held under one arm in front of the body, the satchel strap across the chest, the scarf ends hanging down the front.

The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.

The attached reference sheet shows the character design: take over only the costume, the colours of the clothes and the body proportions. Drawing style, resolution, outlines, shading and palette follow the style described above, not the reference. Isolated on a fully transparent background, both portraits cut off at the waist by the bottom edge of the image.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
